title: workspace-replica-router
blurb: Replica offload makes workspace confirmation pages stale; routing everything to primary would erase the scalability benefit.
brief:
Workspace reads normally use an asynchronous replica. Each committed primary write returns a monotonic position, and tests advance replica application explicitly. Users currently fail to read their own recent renames.

Repair `workspace_data/router.py` without changing the cluster API. Preserve replica reads for unrelated sessions and return to the replica as soon as it satisfies the calling session's dependency.

**Your job:** implement session-scoped read-after-write routing with an observable source and a safe unavailable-replica fallback.
